methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.lead: VScar separates technical capability, running cost and fit for your use. It never mixes them into one score and never forces a winner.
methodology.rightsNote: ESIOS-based electricity prices are only shown in the private preview; publication stays blocked until usage rights are verified.

sections.separateBody: Technical capability, economic fit at your horizon and practical fit are calculated separately. "Best for your needs" only compares vehicles that meet your mandatory requirements.
sections.meaningfulBody: Each spec has its own threshold for a tie, a slight, a meaningful or a clear difference. A second layer says whether it matters for your usage.
sections.confidenceBody: Confidence reflects data quality and how close the result is to changing. It is about the recommendation, not the car.
sections.rangesBody: When official data is a range, every result keeps the interval.
sections.orderBody: First, your hard requirements: a car that fails one cannot be the best for you. Then practical fit with your use, running cost at your horizon and the relevant technical differences. Finally, what would change the result and how confident we are.
sections.practicalBody: Checks your requirements against usable data: meets, meets with compromises, unconfirmed or fails. Unknown data is never treated as a pass.
sections.economicBody: Running cost with your mileage and the market reference prices, at an explicit horizon. We show ranges, not a midpoint, and we never compare consumption from different homologation cycles (NEDC vs WLTP).
